content.text: Both sources are clearly readable. Here's what I found:

input.explanation: The physical driver license card (f009:p7) clearly shows "EXP 06-02-2026" — an expiration date of June 2, 2026, with an issue date of 05-28-2022. The MVR report (f009:p5) shows "Exp Date: 06/02/2030" and also notes a "CDL RENEWAL PROCESSED" entry dated 06/02/2026, confirming the license was renewed after the card was issued. The two documents genuinely reflect different points in time: the physical card predates the renewal, while the MVR reflects the current (post-renewal) expiration of 2030.
